 passed in M.C.O.P.No.89 of 2011, on the file of the Motor Accidents

For Appellant : Mr.C.Jawahar Ravindran
 For Respondents :

 for R2 : No appearance
 *****
 Judgment
The instant appeal has been filed challenging the finding on _____________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis liability.

2. The first respondent had filed a claim petition stating that while he was working as an attender in a bus, insured with the appellant, the driver of the bus drove the bus in a rash and negligent manner and dashed against the tree, as a result of which he sustained grievous injuries.
3. The owner of the vehicle/second respondent remained ex parte before the Tribunal.

4. The appellant filed a counter stating that as per the terms of policy, the appellant is not liable to pay compensation for the attender, as no premium was paid for covering an attender and hence,
Oriental Insurance Company vs Durairengan on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59612152/
1 prayed for dismissal of the claim petition.
5. Before the Tribunal, the first respondent examined himself as P.W.1 and the doctor as P.W.2 and marked Exs.P1 to P6.

The appellant examined R.W.1 and marked the policy document as Ex.R1.
6.

The Tribunal, after taking into consideration the oral and _____________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis documentary evidence, held that the appellant is liable to pay the compensation as per the terms of policy, since the premium was paid for the driver, conductor and cleaner of the bus.

7. The learned counsel for the appellant/Insurance Company submitted that since the claim petition states that he was working as an attender, the appellant would not be liable to pay compensation as the attender is not covered under the policy.

8. The learned counsel for the first respondent/claimant, per contra, submitted that the first respondent was working as an attender-cum- cleaner; that there was no separate cleaner employed in the bus insured with the appellant; and therefore, the Tribunal had rightly awarded the compensation by holding that the appellant is liable to pay the compensation.
9. Though notice has been sent to the second respondent/owner of the bus, none has entered appearance.
10. The only point for consideration in the instant appeal is _____________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
whether
the appellant is liable to pay compensation?
11. It is admitted that as per the terms of policy, the premium has been paid for the driver, conductor and cleaner.
It is also admitted that no separate cleaner was employed in the bus and it is the case of the first respondent that he was working as an attender-cum-cleaner.
Merely because the claimant had referred to his designation as an attender, it cannot be said that he has not been covered under the policy.
What matters is the nature of the job performed by him.

12. The Tribunal held on facts that the first respondent was working as a cleaner and therefore,
entitled to compensation and the said factual finding cannot be faulted and therefore, the compensation awarded by the Tribunal deserves to be confirmed.

13. The appellant/Insurance Company is directed to deposit the award amount of Rs.67,020/-
(Rupees Sixty Seven Thousand and Twenty only), together with interest at 7.5% p.a. from the date of the claim petition till the date of realization (excluding the period of dismissal for default if any) and p r o p o r t i o n a t e c o s t s , l e s s t h e a m o u n t a l r e a d y d e p o s i t e d , _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
if any
, within a period of four (4) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

14. On such deposit, the first respondent/claimant is permitted to withdraw the award amount with interest and costs, less the amount already withdrawn, if any, by filing appropriate application Oriental Insurance Company vs Durairengan on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59612152/
2 before the Tribunal.
15. In the result, this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is dismissed.
No costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
